reason: CP1 covers board-level AFC governance responsibilities, while CP2 covers senior management and operational leaders' responsibilities; they are parallel, complementary roles in the governance structure.
CP1 details the board's role in establishing governance, which prepares the discussion of the benefits of a robust governance structure in CP3.
CP2 details management's implementation and oversight responsibilities, which together with the board's role, lead to the benefits of robust governance described in CP3.
